title: Lizard Wizard's Farewell
description: A large ornate green lizard with orange eyes and a purple floral hood sits on a cliff edge holding a crystal ball that contains a tiny figure inside. In the background, a fantasy castle stands among mountains under a vibrant, swirling cosmic sky with a dragon flying above, while a red-cloaked figure crosses an ornate bridge over a river below.
